_comment: Edit this when you publish a new APK. Size and last-updated are read from the file itself, so they are never wrong here - only version, versionCode and notes live in this file. versionName/versionCode come from mobile/android/app/build.gradle.
notes: Sends from a chosen SIM on dual-SIM phones, including Android 11
Survives being backgrounded: battery-optimisation exemption and auto-start
Keeps its settings when you install an update over the top
Server URL accepts a plain address - any /admin path is ignored
